description: Main source file for the Dashboard module in a SugarCRM-based project. It renders the dashboard interface, including navigation, charts, and user interactions, and includes embedded PHP, HTML, JavaScript, and external resource references.

methods.name: loadDashBoard
methods.description: JavaScript function that loads the selected dashboard view via AJAX, updates the chart area, and updates the dashboard title.

methods.name: changeView
methods.description: JavaScript function to toggle between different display views (NORMAL and MATRIX) and reloads the dashboard accordingly.
